title: Q3LOCK objective coverage and completion-gate audit
question: Does the current Q3LOCK package cover every requested model/result block and publication-boundary requirement without silently promoting the conditional R-497 composition?
method: Check the manuscript's model, pressure, DLR, FKG, reflection/infrared, collective, cusp and parity labels together with the strict sufficient-regime tokens.
Check the EXP-000780 -> EXP-000781 -> EXP-000782 authority chain, all A1-A23 proof-audit rows, the submission-readiness review/PDF gates and the current replay checkpoints.
Reject hostile missing-label, claim-promotion, premature-freeze and missing-authority mutations.
Publish a no-overwrite result with source hashes and a dedicated unit-test replay.
finding: The objective-to-artifact coverage audit passes while reporting INCOMPLETE_EXTERNAL_REVIEW_AND_FREEZE. It covers 14 load-bearing manuscript labels, four strict-regime tokens, the three-record authority chain, all 23 proof-audit rows, the current locator/fresh/integrated replays, the independent child/package replay and the absence of a Q3LOCK paper PDF. The four hostile mutations are rejected.
decision_reason: This is a readiness and provenance improvement, not a mathematical acceptance. It makes the remaining external mathematics, literature, content-freeze and final-PDF gates explicit and machine-checkable without changing R-497's T0 scope.
boundary: T0 objective-coverage audit only; claim_bearing=false; no theorem promotion, proof-row closure, result-tier change, phase conclusion, sector closure or PDF status change.
next_action: Give the completion-gate report with the A1-A23 matrix and theorem/literature crosswalk to independent reviewers; obtain signed dispositions, then perform final content/hash freeze before the first PDF.
non_claims: No proof row is signed or closed by this audit.
No theorem applicability, form closure, thermodynamic limit, DLR pair, cusp, novelty or priority conclusion follows.
No TECT sector, C6, CP1, Pre-A or Sector-A closure changes.
No Q3LOCK paper PDF was generated.
